data.title: Rheb is an essential regulator of S6K in controlling cell growth in Drosophila
data.authors: Stocker H; Radimerski T; Schindelholz B; Wittwer F; Belawat P; Daram P; Breuer S; Thomas G; Hafen E

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure

data.finding: Rheb is an essential regulator of S6K controlling cell growth downstream of TSC in Drosophila.
data.abstract_excerpt: Understanding the mechanisms through which multicellular organisms regulate cell, organ and body growth is of relevance to developmental biology and to research on growth-related diseases such as cancer. Here we describe a new effector in growth control, the small GTPase Rheb (Ras homologue enriched in brain). Mutations in the Drosophila melanogaster Rheb gene were isolated as growth-inhibitors, whereas overexpression of Rheb promoted cell growth.
